record.summary: The no-build-step browser console: live charts (throughput, backlog, latency, absorption) fed over WebSocket with rates derived from cumulative counters, stat tiles, the fault console (link/dup/reorder/rate/kill/reset), the event log, and the per-well live grid. Dark-only ops aesthetic; the validated reference palette's dark steps.
record.title: Dashboard: the night-shift console
